name: Organ Donation
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity of the human body as God's creation, fashioned with care as seen when God took a rib from Adam to form Eve, closing the flesh in its place. While we are reminded that our bodies return to dust upon death, the command to love our neighbor as ourselves and to withhold good from no one when it is within our power calls believers to consider acts of mercy and sacrifice. The prohibition against consuming blood reflects a respect for life and the body, suggesting that any decision regarding organ donation must honor God's design and the dignity of the human person.
